name: Total War: Warhammer 3 unit control & custom AI mod

mentions.name: Total War: Warhammer 3 unit control & custom AI mod
mentions.description: This is a Total War: Warhammer 3 mod that improves control over units and adds custom AI so the player does not have to micromanage everything during battles. Built with AI-assisted coding, with a basic version already working.
mentions.problem: The author long wanted better unit control and custom AI in Total War games to avoid micromanaging every unit, but assumed it would be too time-consuming and distracting from their main work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I finally started modding a total war game (Warhammer 3). I played the series since the very first title, Shogun and I always wanted to improve the control over units and add my custom AI to not micromanage everything
